title: A sign-up form
hints: Work the errors out with computed: an array to which you push "Name is required" and so on, in order.
Keep a ref such as tried, set it to true in send(), and show the errors only when it is true: <template v-if="tried">.
In send(): if (errors.value.length > 0) return; then emit("submit", { name: name.value, email: email.value, plan: plan.value });
The checkbox: <input id="terms" type="checkbox" v-model="terms">. The select: <select id="plan" v-model="plan"> with three <option value="...">.
